causes.text: Spirit AeroSystems workers walked out after voting to reject a tentative contract, triggering a strike at the Wichita factory.

source_info.title: Spirit AeroSystems to halt work at Wichita plant as union votes to strike

effects.text: Boeing shares fell as the strike at a key fuselage supplier threatened 737 output and deliveries.

source_info.title: Spirit AeroSystems Shuts Down Production Ahead of Strike; Boeing, Airbus also decline

causal_reasoning_chain.description: Labor action halts output at a critical upstream supplier of Boeing.
Markets anticipate disrupted fuselage flow to final assembly.
BA stock declines 3% on the expected delivery impact.

rationale: Supplier strike directly jeopardized near-term production schedules, prompting a negative reaction in Boeing's shares.
counterfactual_analysis: If the supplier had not gone on strike, investors would not have priced in a sudden delivery disruption risk.

adversarial_confounders.impact: Could add noise to the immediate stock reaction.

details.commentary: A strike at Spirit AeroSystems immediately constrains fuselage deliveries, forcing Boeing to slow near-term 737 output and disrupting delivery schedules. Once a new contract is reached and production normalizes, that same system gradually releases the pressure, allowing deliveries and investor sentiment to recover.
